latest_teacher_action.diagnosis: The image kept the presence and colors of the required objects, and the four white bears were counted correctly, but it failed the exact count of five mushrooms, the exact count of four toys, the mushrooms-on-top-of-toys relation, and the toys-behind-bears relation. The previous prompt allowed the toys to be partially hidden behind the bears, which likely made the four toys hard to count and also weakened the visual support surfaces for the mushrooms.
expected_improvement: Four toys should become separately countable because they will be arranged in four clear back-row slots with visible tops.
Five pink mushrooms should become separately countable because they will be assigned explicitly as 2, 1, 1, and 1 across the four toys.
The mushrooms-on-toys relation should improve because every mushroom will be visibly seated directly on a toy top.
The toys-behind-bears relation should improve because the scene will use a clear two-depth layout: bears in the lower foreground and toys in a higher back row behind them.
preserve_constraints: Keep mushrooms present and make all mushrooms pink.

previous_plan_error.details: The earlier layered composition relied on partially visible toys behind the bears. That made the toys easy to occlude or merge, and the mushrooms could appear disconnected from the toys or placed elsewhere. The five-mushroom count was also embedded in a sentence rather than reinforced with a simple left-to-right distribution.
previous_plan_error.error_source: Weak spatial_layout and quantity_counting execution under occlusion; the plan did not make the four toy surfaces visible enough for both counting and mushroom placement.

latest_teacher_action.regeneration_strategy: Use a simple front-facing staged layout with two clear rows: four white bears in the lower foreground and four separate toys directly behind them in a higher back row, with the tops of all toys visible above the bears. Put the five pink mushrooms directly on those toy tops in a left-to-right distribution of 2, 1, 1, and 1. Emphasize separation, visibility, and no extras.
regression_risks: The generator may add extra mushrooms or toys when trying to decorate the scene.
The bears might occlude the toys too much, causing the toy count to fail again.
The mushrooms might float above the toys or land on bears instead of resting on toy tops.
The white color of the bears or pink color of the mushrooms could regress if not explicitly preserved.
repair_constraints: Show exactly five pink mushrooms, all separate and countable; no extra mushrooms.
Show exactly four toys, all separate and countable; no extra toys.
Place the mushrooms on top of the toys: two mushrooms on top of the leftmost toy, one mushroom on top of each of the other three toys.
Put the four toys behind the four white bears in a clear back row, with each toy directly behind or slightly above a bear and with each toy top visible.
Keep exactly four white bears in the foreground, separated and countable, with no extra bears.

On top of the four toys are exactly five pink mushrooms total: place two separate pink mushrooms on top of the leftmost toy, one pink mushroom on top of the second toy, one pink mushroom on top of the third toy, and one pink mushroom on top of the rightmost toy. No extra mushrooms, no extra toys, no extra bears, minimal occlusion.
